description: Dynamic-cascading-failure-simulator, published by YitianDai, automates dynamic cascading-failure scenarios in DIgSILENT PowerFactory through Python and processes their results. Coverage: The documented software is configured for the chosen system; the reviewed pages establish no fixed geographic coverage, spatial resolution or time horizon. Source and documentation are publicly accessible through the repository; no model files were downloaded or executed. The licence is BSD-3-Clause. The free cost label refers to repository access; external software or services can have separate costs. Limitations: The documented setup also depends on MATLAB, MATPOWER and the MATLAB Engine API; external licences may be needed. For catalogue screening, its documented functions support cascading failure, resilience studies; this is an assessment of possible use, not a claim of validated performance. Related records: Catalogue records for comparison are model-matpower. Compatibility with these records has not been assumed.
